S1 gives a new excess levy of $12.3 million a year at $0.95 to $0.82 per $1,000 (S2: 88 cents on average). That rate is higher than the Hospital ($0.437) and Mukilteo ($0.57 average) bonds, both scored +2, and far above South County Fire's $0.194, scored +1. The four-year term shortens it but does not make it modest. +2 for consistency across this package.
